subject: CloudSeller marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit evidence
messages:
From: Olivia Barr <olivia@cloudseller.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudSeller marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit evidence

Hi team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our current marketplace addendum (v1) — please review the pass-through clauses (Section 4) and the audit/evidence requirements (Section 7). A few specific asks from our side:

- Can Redwood accept invoice pass-through with the routing language in 4.b?
- We need a clear delegation/signer matrix for reseller evidence (who signs what when an audit is requested).
- Audit window: we typically require 36 months; do you have concerns about logs/retention for that period?

I've copied Procurement in case they want to coordinate timing for DocuSign and evidence uploads.

Attachments: CloudSeller_Marketplace_Addendum_v1.docx

Thanks,
Olivia Barr
Head of Partner Contracts
CloudSeller Inc.
[Attachment: CloudSeller_Marketplace_Addendum_v1.docx]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barr <olivia@cloudseller.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSeller marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit evidence

Olivia — thanks for the doc. Quick read-through and initial thoughts:

- Invoice pass-through: the routing language is reasonable, but we need to limit Redwood's indemnity exposure tied to third-party reseller claims. Can your legal team add a carve-out that caps Redwood's liability to direct invoicing errors and omits consequential damages for pass-through items?

- Delegation / signer matrix: we'll propose a short template (attaching). Our preference is a two-tier delegation: (1) Seller (CloudSeller) owns customer invoicing and notice of claim; (2) Redwood provides evidence on request within 10 business days via a secure evidence share. That keeps the operational burden off Redwood.

- Audit window & logs: 36 months is fine, but we need to clarify data residency for any raw telemetry. For on-hosted API customers we can provide aggregated invoice traces and per-deal audit bundles. For Dedicated/Private deployments we will need a scoped rider.

Attaching: RS-Delegation-Template.xlsx (template for signer/delegation table). Can you review and confirm if Procurement will accept the 10-business-day turnaround? Also please confirm who will sign the addendum for CloudSeller (name & title) so we can pre-fill DocuSign.

Thanks — cc'ing Laura for legal wording and Marissa for partner ops.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships & Commercials
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RS-Delegation-Template.xlsx]

Subject: Re: CloudSeller marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit evidence

Karthik/Team,

Thanks for the quick response. We ran Redwood's proposed carve-out by our GC — they are ok with limiting indemnity provided Redwood accepts responsibilities in Section 7 for producing audit evidence. To get to final form we are returning a redline PDF with two asks: (1) stronger language around chain-of-custody for evidence transfers and (2) confirmation of the 10-business-day SLA for producing evidence (we prefer 7 business days).

DocuSign: we prepared a preliminary sign package and placed a placeholder for Redwood's signer. Link below — please confirm signers so Procurement can finalize routing.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/?env=prod&txn=0AB1C2D3

We attached our redline for ease of review.

Attachments: CS_Addendum_Redlines_20270603.pdf

Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudSeller marketplace addendum — pass-through & audit evidence

Procurement — appreciate the redline and the DocuSign link. Quick answers and next steps:

1) Evidence SLA: Redwood can accept a 7-business-day SLA for standard audit bundles (invoice traces, signed orderforms, and per-deal usage summaries). For requests requiring raw telemetry or logs from Dedicated/Private deployments we will flag as "extended" and propose a scoped statement of work and timeline (typically 15-30 business days).

2) Chain-of-custody: we can add explicit requirements for secure transfer (SFTP/secure drive URL with MD5 hash and expiry) and a short acknowledgment workflow so both parties record receipt. Laura, please suggest two short clauses we can insert under Section 7.

3) Indemnity carve-out: happy to accept the carve-out limiting Redwood to direct invoicing errors and excluding consequential damages related to pass-through items. Legal to confirm exact wording.

4) Signer: please route DocuSign to me (Karthik Iyer, Head of Partnerships & Commercials) and copy Ben Carter for billing ops. Once redlines are agreed we can sign and return within 48 hours.

Next steps: Laura to draft the two clauses; Marissa to confirm operational handoffs for evidence uploads and the secure share location. Procurement: once we have final redline we'll ask that you update the DocuSign package and set routing to my email.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships & Commercials
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RS-Delegation-Template.xlsx (updated)]
